verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no AI-generated insights or suggestions produced inside GitCafe itself. What it does document is an MCP server for external AI tools, a button that hands an issue or pull request off to third-party coding agents, WebMCP tools for a browser's agent, and llms.txt repository summaries. These let outside AI consume GitCafe data; they are not native in-product insights, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
